subject: fix(gdn): preserve cached decode arithmetic in mixed batches

requirement.behavior: On Xe2, eligible ordinary one-token cached decodes must use the same native arithmetic path when sharing a batch with prefills as when run alone. Preserve exact core attention output, gate output, convolution state and recurrent state for both request classes.
requirement.original_failure: Upstream gated_delta_rule_non_spec selects the XE2 chunk kernel whenever num_prefills > 0. A cached decode consequently moves from its standalone recurrent arithmetic path to chunk arithmetic merely because another request is prefilling.
requirement.mechanism: An opt-in split_mixed_non_spec argument partitions contiguous decode-first non-spec batches into decode and prefill views, adjusts prefill query offsets, runs the existing conv/delta pipeline for each group, and retains both intermediate sets until their kernels have been enqueued. The default remains false.
requirement.supported_workload: Intel B70/Xe2 Qwen GDN non-speculative mixed batches, including supported alternative serving profiles. The current V2 DFlash2 profile uses speculative decoding; its speculative batches are intentionally excluded. This is a retained arithmetic policy, not an established speedup for the current deployed profile.
requirement.final_old_stack: All four paths changed by this commit are byte-identical from this commit through the old final kernel tip. No follow-up or revert supersedes its contribution.

upstream_coverage.finding: Selected kernel base is unchanged. The fused entry point sends the entire non-spec token group through one conv/delta chain with the original num_prefills/num_decodes. The delta wrapper selects chunk_gated_delta_rule_xe2 whenever a prefill is present; the standalone cached-decode route requires num_prefills == 0. No upstream mixed split supplies the requested arithmetic preservation.

v0.33 adds explicit SYCL/Triton GDN selection, but auto still chooses SYCL when the native op is available. SYCL uses the unchanged adapter (old and target blob 166534e5b1a78c28fe4820005835959758bae20c), with no split keyword. Availability of an unqualified alternate Triton implementation does not demonstrate equivalent behavior or justify removing the native safeguard. Preserve upstream backend selection while retaining the paired adapter gate.

Newer upstream GDN changes skip NULL state rows, honor DeepSeek convolution-state layout, widen offsets, add speculative RecoverSSM, and repair ragged speculative traversal. They do not separate ordinary decode rows from mixed prefills or replace the arithmetic policy. Both gdn_attention and gated_delta_rule_non_spec are exactly unchanged between the selected base and v0.1.17.
upstream_coverage.newer_base_disposition: KEEP would still be required for the same supported native behavior if v0.1.17 were adopted; this report does not select that newer pair.

disposition_reason: The selected upstream base retains the failure mechanism, v0.33 retains its native caller, and newer kernel fixes address different failure modes. There is no demonstrated semantic replacement for preserving standalone cached-decode arithmetic in an eligible mixed native batch.
minimum_residual: Retain the split_mixed_non_spec default-false Torch schema, C++ declaration/implementation, Xe2 partitioning and existing regression as one coherent fix.

Retain the companion vLLM adapter's conservative gate: both prefill and decode requests, one token per decode, all tokens accounted for, no speculative decodes, no token indirection and no spec sequence masks.
Preserve upstream SYCL/Triton selection. Do not broaden the native split to speculative, indexed or differently packed batches during the rebase.
The companion Qwen backend identity can be scoped to XPU as recommended by its owning audit without changing this native operator ABI.

dependencies.contract: Adds the split_mixed_non_spec keyword at the native call boundary. Removing only the native schema causes an unknown-argument failure. Removing only the caller leaves this optional native path unused and abandons the requested policy. The native default preserves upstream callers that omit the argument.

The split calls the existing convolution and delta implementations, inheriting their untiled-prefill choice and fresh-state ordering fix. Those independent correctness requirements remain owned by their separate audits; splitting a batch does not replace them.

performed: Read full assigned production/test diff, selected upstream implementation, companion adapter change and v0.33 native/Triton call paths.
git diff --quiet assigned_commit..old_tip over all four assigned paths passed, proving no later local modification or revert.
Extracted and compared complete upstream gdn_attention and gated_delta_rule_non_spec functions between selected base and v0.1.17; both comparisons passed.

Parsed final tests/gdn_attn/test_gdn_attn.py with ast.parse using the existing uv-created candidate virtualenv; confirmed test_qwen38_gdn_cached_decode_is_exact_in_mixed_prefill and its bitwise comparison remain present. No module import or accelerator execution was performed.
gpu_required: Run tests/gdn_attn/test_gdn_attn.py::test_qwen38_gdn_cached_decode_is_exact_in_mixed_prefill against the paired installed candidate. It compares one cached decode and one 127-token fresh prefill alone versus the split mixed call, requiring exact output, z, convolution-state and SSM-state equality.
Retain tests for pure decode, pure prefill and speculative mixed paths to establish that default-false and ineligible callers preserve their behavior.

For any future proposal to drop the split, compare upstream-alone and split-enabled behavior on the same inputs and native build; a textual upstream fix or tolerance-only check does not establish this bitwise contract.
validation.performance: No controlled performance measurement was run. Native split adds partition/launch work and primarily preserves an arithmetic policy; no current-profile speed improvement is claimed. Any policy change requires a matched correctness/latency comparison after operator GPU handoff.
validation.limitations: No source edits, native compilation, GPU work, service changes or runtime qualification in this audit.
